hints.title: Greedy Line Fitting
hints.text: Pack as many words as possible into each line such that their lengths plus minimum single spaces do not exceed maximum width.

hints.title: Space Distribution Round-Robin
hints.text: Distribute remaining spaces evenly between word slots. Distribute any extra spaces one by one starting from the leftmost slots.

hints.title: Handling Single-Word and Final Lines
hints.text: If a line contains only one word or is the last line of text, left-align it by placing single spaces between words and padding the remainder with trailing spaces to meet the target width. Otherwise distribute surplus spaces as evenly as possible across gaps.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def fullJustify(self, words: List[str], maxWidth: int) -> List[str]:
        res = []
        line = []
        length = 0

        for word in words:
            if length + len(line) + len(word) > maxWidth:
                for i in range(maxWidth - length):
                    line[i % (len(line) - 1 or 1)] += " "
                res.append("".join(line))
                line, length = [], 0
            line.append(word)
            length += len(word)

        res.append(" ".join(line).ljust(maxWidth))
        return res
```

variables: N: total number of characters in words
complexity.notes: Optimal linear pass packing words and allocating inter-word spacing.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking across line splits is unnecessary since greedy word packing is required.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Buffer word segments line-by-line and format spaces round-robin.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly distinguish middle lines from left-aligned last lines or lines with a single word.
